jobs.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Global FX and Cross-Border Solutions team is charged with leading the strategy, design, build, and commercialization of best-in-class flexible enterprise-wide FX and Cross-Border solutions as we seek to meet the growing and increasingly diversified needs of clients moving funds around the world. What’s it all about? As Senior Multi-Currency Cards Product Manager, Global FX & Cross-Border Issuer Solutions , you will be responsible for defining and executing the roadmap for Visa's multi-currency card capabilities, driving product strategy from concept through execution while partnering closely with technology, operations, regional teams and clients. The successful candidate will combine a deep understanding of multi-currency wallets, cardholder needs and Visa capabilities to develop innovative solutions that help issuers around the world deliver differentiated multi-currency card propositions. Working at the intersection of product strategy, payments, FX and technology, you will translate market opportunities and business objectives into scalable product solutions through detailed requirements, transaction flows, prototypes and technical designs. The role requires strong product thinking and commercial acumen, with the ability to evaluate and prioritise product investments by balancing client needs, cardholder expectations, technical feasibility and strategic objectives. Success in this role requires understanding how consumers increasingly want to hold, manage and spend across multiple currencies, and translating those needs into capabilities that create value for issuers and cardholders alike. This is an opportunity to influence products used by issuers across Visa's global network, helping shape the next generation of multi-currency card experiences and enabling issuers to deliver greater flexibility, transparency and control to globally connected consumers. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Gen AI tools (e.g. Replit, Copilot, Figma AI, Claude Code etc) to enable everyday work. What we expect of you, day to day. Product Design & Solution Architecture Own the definition and development of customer-centric product and technical requirements for multi-currency card solutions, using AI-powered tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, validation and design. Develop a deep understanding of the end-to-end multi-currency solution architecture, including the interaction between systems. Translate cardholder journeys, issuer needs, market opportunities and business objectives into prioritised functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, workflow models, prototypes and scalable solution designs. Map end-to-end transaction flows across authorisation, clearing and settlement. Develop system context diagrams, sequence diagrams, data flows, interface specifications and system interaction models that clearly define component responsibilities, system dependencies and integration requirements. Partner closely with Technology, Processing and Architecture teams to evaluate solution options, understand existing system capabilities and constraints, and assess technical feasibility, scalability, resilience, security and implementation complexity. Engage confidently in detailed technical discussions, challenging assumptions and helping teams make informed architectural decisions and trade-offs across customer experience, issuer integration, platform capability, delivery effort and future scalability. Define integration requirements for issuer processors and multi-currency platforms, including APIs, payment messages, data exchanges, event flows, configuration requirements and operational processes. Identify architecture gaps, upstream and downstream dependencies, data requirements, edge cases and failure scenarios early in the product development lifecycle. Ensure product and technical designs address operational considerations, including monitoring, reconciliation, dispute and exception management, controls, reporting, support models and production readiness. Lead technical discovery workshops, client design sessions, architecture reviews and solution walkthroughs with issuers, processors, technology partners and internal stakeholders. Maintain clear traceability from cardholder and issuer needs through product requirements, technical design, development and testing, ensuring the delivered solution achieves the intended customer and commercial outcomes. Use AI-enabled product and development tools to accelerate requirements analysis, prototype creation, technical documentation and solution validation, while applying appropriate review, governance and judgement. Product Strategy & Portfolio Prioritisation Define the future vision for Visa's multi-currency issuer capabilities and identify opportunities to address emerging cardholder and issuer needs. Partner directly with issuers, fintechs and regional teams to understand evolving multi-currency propositions, customer expectations and competitive dynamics. Identify strategic opportunities through client engagement, market research, competitive analysis and industry developments. Evaluate product initiatives and investment opportunities based on client value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, implementation complexity, scalability and strategic alignment. Develop business cases, market assessments and value frameworks to support investment and prioritisation decisions. Partner with regional, commercial and product teams to gather market insights and validate investment opportunities. Assess build, buy and partner opportunities to address product capability gaps, recommending the optimal approach based on strategic, commercial and technical considerations, and supporting partnership commercials, contracting and execution. Recommend product roadmap priorities, sequencing and investment allocation based on expected business impact, resource constraints and strategic objectives. Support annual planning, portfolio reviews and investment discussions with senior leadership. Monitor product performance, adoption and commercial outcomes, using Gen AI and data-driven insights to refine strategy and prioritise future investments. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Demonstrated experience working with payment processing platforms and technologies, including VIP, BASE II, authorisation, clearing, settlement and transaction lifecycle management. Experience designing and documenting complex solutions through BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, transaction flows and solution design documentation. Experience working with multi-currency, wallet, FX or banking platforms such as Currencycloud is highly desirable. 5-8+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, payments, FX, multicurrency solutions, issuer processing or cross-border payments. Proven ability to gather requirements, solve complex business and technical problems, and translate them into scalable product solutions. Experience partnering with Technology, Processing, Operations and Architecture teams to deliver product enhancements and strategic initiatives. Experience supporting product roadmap development, business case creation, revenue drivers, financial models and portfolio prioritisation. Strong analytical, strategic thinking and prioritisation skills, with the ability to assess opportunities based on client value, commercial impact, technical feasibility and strategic alignment. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Application Security team secures the systems that build, serve, and increasingly are Claude — and as Anthropic's footprint grows, that mandate now extends to companies and codebases we bring in from outside. This role establishes that function.

You'll own security due diligence and secure integration for Anthropic's acquisitions — assessing a target's security posture pre-close, writing the security risk readout for leadership, and after close, bringing acquired systems up to Anthropic's bar. Security has been part of every deal to date, but this is the first dedicated role for it: you'll formalize the playbook, the risk model, and the tooling, and make them repeatable.

This is an AppSec role first. You'll be an active member of the Application Security team — same rituals, same on-run rotation, same tooling, working alongside engineers securing Anthropic's own agentic product surfaces. The expectation is the same too: we use Claude as our primary tool, and you're expected to automate the repeatable parts of diligence and integration as you go, so each acquisition is easier than the last. When deal flow is quiet, you'll pick up core AppSec project work; when it's active, M&A is your priority.

We're upfront that the center of gravity here is M&A rather than core product security. It's burstier, more assessment-heavy, and operates on confidential, time-sensitive work. If you like parachuting into an unfamiliar codebase under time pressure and turning it into a clear risk picture for leadership, this is that job.

Key responsibilities

• Lead pre-close security due diligence on prospective acquisitions — coordinate external penetration testing, threat-model the target's architecture, assess security controls, and deliver the security risk readout for leadership ahead of close and integration planning
• Drive post-close security integration — stand up static and dynamic analysis coverage on acquired codebases, track high- and critical-severity remediation to closure, fold acquired assets into bug bounty scope, and onboard repositories to Anthropic's automated vulnerability remediation and reporting systems
• Coordinate adjacent security engineering teams (supply chain, cloud, corporate security, detection & response) on their portions of each integration
• Work across a wide set of stakeholders on every deal — corporate development, legal, security leadership, and the engineering teams inheriting acquired systems internally; engineering and security counterparts at the target company externally — translating between them and keeping the security workstream legible to all of them
• Formalize and scale Anthropic's M&A security playbook — risk-scoring model, diligence runbook, integration checklist — and turn as much of it as possible into Claude-powered tooling rather than manual process
• Share the team's operational on-run rotation (bug bounty escalations, launch consults, incident response), swapping out during periods of active deal work
• Contribute to core AppSec projects between deals — secure design reviews, threat modeling for agentic systems, and the team's security automation roadmap

Minimum qualifications

• Hands-on application and infrastructure security experience, including cloud and containerized environments
• Demonstrated ability to rapidly assess an unfamiliar codebase or architecture and produce a clear, prioritized risk assessment for a non-security audience
• Production-quality coding ability in at least one of Python, Go, Rust, or TypeScript
• Practical threat-modeling and vulnerability-identification skills — you've found and reasoned about real bugs in real systems
• Comfort operating with high autonomy, ambiguity, and tightly-held confidential context
• Clear written and verbal communication across varied audiences — executives, legal and corporate development partners, and engineering counterparts at an acquired company

Preferred qualifications

• 7+ years in application security, security consulting, or security architecture
• Prior M&A security due diligence, third-party security assessment, or technical due diligence experience
• Experience standing up or scaling SAST/DAST, bug bounty, or vulnerability management coverage across multiple codebases
• Track record of building security automation or tooling rather than relying solely on manual review
• Familiarity with using LLMs as a core part of your security workflow
• Experience securing agentic, code-execution, or LLM-integrated systems

Representative projects

• Point Anthropic's internal LLM-driven code analysis and AI-assisted scanning at an acquired repository nobody here has seen, and turn the output into a prioritized remediation plan in days rather than weeks
• Design the risk-scoring framework Anthropic uses to compare security posture across acquisitions of different shapes and sizes
• Build the automation that onboards an acquired codebase to Anthropic's vulnerability dashboard, dependency auto-patching, and bounty scope without a human running a checklist
• Write the security risk memo for a live deal and present it to corporate development and security leadership

We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. jobs.description: En tant que membre de l'Agence créative Gameloft, sous la supervision du responsable de l'animation 2D, l'artiste en animation graphique collaborera étroitement avec les équipes Marketing et Acquisition d'utilisateurs. La responsabilité principale sera de créer du contenu vidéo captivant, y compris des bandes-annonces à des fins de marketing variées, qui seront publiées sur des plateformes telles que Google Play, l'App Store, le Microsoft Store, Steam, PlayStation®, Nintendo et Xbox. De plus, le rôle implique la production de publicités vidéo adaptées pour différents canaux de performance, notamment Facebook, Google Ads, TikTok, YouTube et plus encore. L'artiste créera des contenus vidéo pour différents jeux, chacun avec son style visuel et de communication distincts, toujours dans le but d'engager les utilisateurs et de les encourager à télécharger le jeu. Responsabilités du poste : Production Créer un contenu vidéo de haute qualité pour améliorer les efforts de marketing et attirer de nouveaux utilisateurs engagés pour nos jeux. Prendre en charge la totalité du processus de production vidéo, du développement du concept jusqu'à la livraison finale. Capturer des images captivantes en jeu directement depuis le moteur de jeu ou la version de développement du jeu. Adapter les vidéos en divers formats, en veillant à leur optimisation pour des plateformes et canaux de distribution différents. Gérer la compression, le codage et les normes de formatage vidéo pour le Web, les réseaux sociaux et d'autres plateformes. Améliorer la qualité globale des vidéos en incorporant des effets sonores, de la musique, du texte, des graphismes et d'autres éléments. Communication Intégrer les retours des clients (responsable / équipes internes / détenteur de licence) et s'assurer que les révisions sont effectuées selon les spécifications et dans les délais. S'adapter rapidement aux retours des parties prenantes, y compris les équipes Marketing, Juridique et Licences, en veillant à ce que le produit final soit conforme aux exigences. Participer aux réunions et contribuer régulièrement avec des idées nouvelles et créatives. Contribuer à l'orientation créative des contenus vidéo, en façonnant la narration et le ton global des vidéos marketing. Cohérence et directives Apprendre et respecter les directives relatives à la création artistique, à la propriété intellectuelle et aux licences. Assurer la cohérence de la marque sur tous les supports vidéo, en maintenant un style visuel et narratif cohérent à travers les campagnes et les plateformes. Organisation et rapports Gérer et tenir à jour une bibliothèque d'assets vidéo, en organisant des séquences brutes, des vidéos montées et des ressources pour un accès facile et une utilisation future. Surveiller la performance des annonces vidéo et collaborer avec les équipes internes pour améliorer les résultats en fournissant des informations et des recommandations. Innovation Utiliser la créativité et l'innovation pour proposer de nouvelles idées et de nouveaux formats afin d'améliorer la production vidéo. Offrir des suggestions créatives pour les projets vidéo, en se concentrant sur la narration visuelle, le rythme et le design global. Se tenir au courant des tendances sur les plateformes de jeux et de vidéos, en appliquant les innovations pertinentes à la création de contenu. Résultats attendus : Qualité des assets Vous livrez systématiquement des assets vidéo finalisés et complets qui respectent le brief créatif, les spécifications techniques, les exigences de la plateforme, l'identité du jeu, les standards de marque et les directives de licence. Exécution de la production Vous prenez en charge vos projets du brief jusqu'à la livraison finale, gérez efficacement votre charge de travail, maintenez un rythme de production constant et fiable et respectez les délais convenus. Vous communiquez rapidement en cas d'informations manquantes, de limitations techniques ou de priorités changeantes susceptibles d'affecter la livraison. Collaboration et communication Vous collaborez efficacement avec le responsable de l'Agence créative, d'autres artistes, ainsi qu'avec les équipes Marketing, Acquisition d'utilisateurs et Juridique, les détenteurs de licences et d'autres parties prenantes. Vous posez des questions pertinentes, répondez de manière constructive aux retours, et conservez la progression et l'état de votre travail de manière claire et visible. Contribution créative Vous comprenez l'objectif, le public, la plateforme et les buts de chaque brief. Vous apportez des idées pertinentes et utilisez la narration visuelle, le montage, le rythme, l'animation graphique, la capture de gameplay, le son, les graphismes et les éléments 3D pour créer du contenu attrayant et efficace. Développement continu Vous développez activement vos compétences créatives et techniques, appliquez les retours et enseignements relatifs aux performances aux travaux futurs, partagez des connaissances utiles avec l'équipe, et contribuez à l'amélioration des outils de production, des flux de travail et des pratiques. *** As a member of the Gameloft Creative Agency, the Motion Designer will report to the 2D Motion Lead and collaborate closely with the Marketing and User Acquisition Team. The primary responsibility will be to create captivating video content, including trailers for various marketing purposes, to be published across platforms such as Google Play, App Store, Microsoft Store, Steam, PlayStation®, Nintendo, and Xbox. Additionally, the role involves producing video ads tailored for different performance channels, including Facebook, Google Ads, TikTok, YouTube, and more. The artist will be creating video content for different games, each with its distinct visual and communication style, always with the goal of engaging users and encouraging them to download the game. Job Responsibilities: Production Create high-quality video content to enhance marketing efforts and attract new, engaged users for our games. Take full ownership of the video production process, from concept development to final delivery. Capture engaging in-game footage directly from the game engine or game build. Adapt videos into various formats, ensuring optimization for different platforms and distribution channels. Manage video compression, encoding, and formatting standards for web, social media, and other platforms. Enhance overall video quality by incorporating sound effects, music, text, graphics, and other elements. Communication Incorporate client feedback (lead / internal teams / licensor) and ensure revisions are completed on spec and on time. Adapt quickly to feedback from stakeholders, including marketing, legal, and licensing teams, ensuring the final product aligns with requirements. Participate in meetings and consistently contribute fresh, creative ideas. Provide input into the creative direction for video content, shaping the overall narrative and tone of marketing videos. Consistency & Guidelines Learn and adhere to artistic, IP, and licensing guidelines. Ensure brand consistency across all video materials, maintaining a cohesive visual and narrative style across campaigns and platforms. Organization & Reporting Manage and maintain a video asset library, organizing raw footage, edited videos, and assets for easy access and future use. Monitor the performance of video ads and collaborate with internal teams to improve results by providing insights and recommendations. Innovation Use creativity and innovation to propose new ideas and formats to elevate video production. Offer creative suggestions for video projects, focusing on visual storytelling, pacing, and overall design. Keep up with trends in gaming and video platforms, applying relevant innovations to content creation. Expected Results: Asset Quality You consistently deliver polished and complete video assets that meet the creative brief, technical specifications, platform requirements, game identity, brand standards, and licensing guidelines. Production Execution You take ownership of your projects from brief to final delivery, manage your workload effectively, maintain a steady and reliable production pace, and meet agreed deadlines. You communicate early when missing information, technical limitations, or changing priorities may affect delivery. Collaboration and Communication You collaborate effectively with the Creative Agency Lead, other artists, Marketing, User Acquisition, Legal, licensors, and other stakeholders. You ask relevant questions, respond constructively to feedback, and keep the progress and status of your work clear and visible. Creative Contribution You understand the purpose, audience, platform, and objectives behind each brief. You contribute relevant ideas and use visual storytelling, editing, pacing, motion design, gameplay capture, sound, graphics, and 3D elements to create engaging and effective content. Continuous Improvement You actively develop your creative and technical skills, apply feedback and performance learnings to future work, share useful knowledge with the team, and contribute to improving production tools, workflows, and practices. Notre candidat(e) idéal(e) possédera les qualités suivantes : Sens aigu de la créativité et de l'innovation. Parfaite maîtrise de l'anglais avec d'excellentes compétences en communication. Expertise dans la création de contenu vidéo. Expérience approfondie en montage vidéo, animation graphique et conception graphique, en particulier avec des logiciels Adobe comme Premiere, After Effects et Photoshop. Capacité de gérer de manière autonome l'ensemble du processus créatif, de la préparation des assets à la livraison finale, tout en respectant un brief créatif. Capacité de jongler avec plusieurs tâches ayant des échéances concurrentes dans un environnement dynamique. Sens artistique développé, œil attentif aux détails et passion pour l'innovation constante et l'exploration de nouvelles techniques. Volonté d'apprendre à manipuler le contenu du moteur de jeu (formation interne Unity). Portfolio en ligne et/ou bande de démonstration, qui doivent être inclus avec votre candidature. Atouts : Passion et expérience dans le domaine des jeux vidéo. Expérience précédente avec des applis 3D (3ds Max, Blender, Maya, etc.). Expérience préalable avec ces moteurs : Unity, Unreal Engine. *** Our ideal candidate will possess the following qualities: A strong sense of creativity and innovation. Fluency in English with excellent communication skills. Expertise in video content creation. Extensive experience with video editing, motion graphics, and graphic design, particularly using Adobe software like Premiere, After Effects, and Photoshop. Ability to independently manage the entire creative process, from asset preparation to final delivery, while adhering to a creative brief. Capability to juggle multiple tasks with competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Strong artistic sensibilities, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for constantly innovating and exploring new techniques. A willingness to learn about game-engine content manipulation (Unity in-house training). An online portfolio and/or demo reel, which must be included with your application. Pluses: Passion and experience working in video games. Previous experience with 3D applications (3ds Max, Blender, Maya, etc.). Previous experience working with these engines: Unity, Unreal Engine. Ce en quoi Gameloft croit : Nous jouons le jeu pour un monde meilleur. En tant que leader dans l'industrie, nous voulons utiliser le pouvoir des jeux vidéos comme une force positive au changement. En nous rejoignant, vous aurez une multitudes d'opportunités pour aider votre environnement, faire la différence et bâtir un monde plus inclusif. Nous voulons que les Gamelofteurs se concentrent sur l'essentiel: créer du fun et des jeux de haute qualité dont ils pourront être fiers de les partager avec les joueurs du monde entier. *** What Gameloft believes in: We play the good game for a better world. As a leader in the industry, we want to use the power of video games as a force for positive change. If you join us, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to help the environment, make a difference in communities and build a more inclusive world. We want our Gamelofters to focus on what matters: creating fun and high-quality games they’ll be proud to share with our players around the world.
